title: Madhava Calculus & Infinite Series
price: HTML · 1 chapter · not the classical manuscript

chapters.overview: Madhava of Sangamagrama (14th century) discovered the infinite Taylor-Maclaurin series for Sine, Cosine, and Arctangent (Pi) three centuries before European calculus.

slokas.deva:
व्यासे वारिधिनिहते रूपहृते व्याससागराभिहते ।
त्रिशरादिविषमसंख्याभक्तमृणं स्वं पृथक्क्रमात् कुर्यात् ॥
slokas.translit:
vyāse vāridhinihate rūpahṛte vyāsasāgarābhihate |
triśarādiviṣamasaṃkhyābhaktamṛṇaṃ svaṃ pṛthakkramāt kuryāt ||
slokas.translation: Multiply the diameter by 4 and divide it by 1. Then decrease and increase it alternately by the diameter multiplied by 4 and divided by the successive odd numbers 3, 5, 7, etc.

formula.title: Madhava's Infinite Series for Pi (Arctangent)
formula.notes: Known in the West as the Gregory-Leibniz series, discovered by Madhava circa 1350 CE.

chapters.codeSnippet:
def madhava_pi_series(terms):
    pi_fourth = 0
    sign = 1
    for n in range(terms):
        denominator = 2 * n + 1
        pi_fourth += sign * (1 / denominator)
        sign *= -1
    return pi_fourth * 4
